mapper.insert: INSERT INTO domain_event_audit (event_id, event_type, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, user_id, group_id, payload, status, created_at) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{eventType}, #{aggregateType}, #{aggregateId}, #{userId}, #{groupId}, #{payload}, #{status}, NOW())
